Issue Number: close #40561 

Problem Summary:
Add a lock with ttl for checkpoint backup, in order to prevent the same task from being run on different BRs at the same time.

### What is changed and how it works?
1. flush a lock file with ttl to the external storage regularly.

issue_context.title: the same task run on different BRs at the same time when BR use checkpoint mode
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
1. run BR
2. run another BR with the same parameter
<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
1. the second BR runs failed　
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
2. the second BR runs successfully
### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)
master/v6.5.0
<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->

review_comments: How about the stability of `updateLock` function, will it introduce some stability issue for backup?

The function `updateLock` do 3 things in total:
1. get TS from pd with retry.
2. read lock from external storage.
3. write lock to external storage.

it would fail only when pd or external storage is unavailable to BR.
so can we ignore this error. and wait for next time `updateLock` occur?
why 3 seconds? `tickDurationForLock` seems need 4 minutes to finish one `flushLock`.

This lock initialization is not an atomic operation. 
1. BR reads the lock at first to check whether the lock belongs to it or the lock has expired.  (atomic)
2. BR write the lock to external storage. (atomic)

BR-A and BR-B do the step-1 at the same time, they find the lock does not exist or the lock has expired. So they are both go to the step-2.

If there is no check again, both BRs will begin to backup file. So we wait for 3 seconds to determine whether multi BRs do step-1 at the same time.
